einzeiler: Celebrating 300 episodes with a deep dive into the Law & Order: SVU episode featuring…
kurzfassung: The hosts celebrate their 300th episode by recapping a memorable Law & Order: SVU episode guest-starring John Stamos as a serial procreator. They discuss the plot involving an abandoned baby and reproductive abuse, and they share behind-the-scenes stories with Stamos himself in a special interview. The episode also covers real-world true crime cases related to the themes and highlights the hosts' ongoing dedication to the podcast.
stichpunkte: The hosts celebrate their milestone 300th episode of the podcast.
A recap of Law & Order: SVU season 12, episode 22 ('Bang'), guest-starring John Stamos.
Discussion of the episode's plot involving an abandoned baby, a manipulative Wall Street lawyer, and reproductive abuse.
An in-depth interview with John Stamos discussing his role, meeting his wife on set, and his career.
Exploration of the true crime case of Dusty Bowers and the British 'love rat dad' Keith McDonald.
Analysis of reproductive abuse and the legal landscape surrounding stealthing.
A segment dedicated to thanking listeners and sharing personal updates, including New York adventures and purchases.
